title: NPU Models Tests fail installing TF Models tests requirements, unrelated to NPUW SWA runtime utils PR
signature: TensorFlow Models tests requirements pip install failure, unrelated to NPU code change|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: NPU Models Tests / 4000
failed_jobs.symptom: Step 'Install TF Models tests requirements' failed at 00:05:19-00:05:46, causing 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)' to fail; JAX/Flax and both PyTorch groups A/B in the same job passed and the job's own conclusion is 'failure' solely because of this unrelated pip-install step.

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status job failed because it depends on 'NPU Models Tests / 4000'.

key_errors: Job log for 'NPU Models Tests / 4000' (id 103093884642) has no explicit stdout error text retrievable for step 9 'Install TF Models tests requirements' within the tool's tail-anchored log window (tool consistently returns only the last ~5000 lines regardless of a larger tail_lines value, which lands after this step); the job's step list confirms step 9 'Install TF Models tests requirements' (00:05:19Z-00:05:46Z) and step 11 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)' both concluded 'failure', while steps 12-13 (JAX/Flax) and 14+ (PyTorch groups A/B) succeeded normally afterward.

Job environment (visible in the retrieved tail) shows PIP_INDEX_URL=http://pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local/simple/ and PIP_TRUSTED_HOST=pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local, the same internal pip-proxy dependency implicated in the prior occurrence of this exact pattern.
root_cause: This PR (#37788) only touches src/plugins/intel_npu/src/plugin/npuw/kv_cache_sliding_window_manager.{cpp,hpp} and adds new unit tests under src/plugins/intel_npu/tests/unit/npuw/ (pure NPUW SWA runtime-utility code, no TensorFlow/pip dependency). All NPU-relevant PyTorch and JAX/Flax compile-only checks in the same 'NPU Models Tests / 4000' job passed. The only failing step is a generic 'Install TF Models tests requirements' pip-install step (unrelated to the PR diff) which then causes the downstream 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)' check to fail. This exact signature (TF Models tests requirements install failing and blocking an otherwise-unrelated NPU PR) was already recorded once before, on 2026-09-04 for PR #37898 (an NPU mutex fix), pointing at the same internal pip-proxy service (pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local) as the likely fault, consistent with an intermittent proxy/package-index hiccup rather than anything in this PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible from the PR diff; re-running the 'Install TF Models tests requirements' step (or the whole 'NPU Models Tests / 4000' job) for run 34541186983 attempt 2 (already in progress at investigation time) will confirm whether the pip install succeeds on retry.
recommended_actions: Let the automatic re-run of the failed 'NPU Models Tests / 4000' job proceed (already triggered); the PR's own NPUW SWA changes are unaffected and unrelated to this failure.

If the exact pip error text is needed for deeper diagnosis, capture the full raw log for the 'Install TF Models tests requirements' step via the GitHub UI, since the log-retrieval tool returns only a fixed ~5000-line tail window that does not reach this step for this job.
Consider adding retry/backoff around the TF Models tests requirements pip install step, as recommended in the prior instance of this same pattern, to reduce recurring unrelated merge-queue failures.
prevention_strategies: Add resilience (automatic retries, dependency caching, or a pre-baked test image) specifically for the 'Install TF Models tests requirements' step so transient internal pip-proxy blips stop blocking unrelated PRs in the merge queue; this is now the second recorded occurrence of the identical signature within roughly a week.
historical_context: Identical signature previously recorded on 2026-09-04 (investigation 2026-09-04-08-38-10-000-33844291174, pattern 6e384cf2944ada58) for PR #37898, also an NPU-focused PR unrelated to TensorFlow. Broader theme: two additional prior investigations flagged separate TF-related pip/network flakiness blocking unrelated PRs (grpcio PyPI truncated-JSON failure, category Network, High confidence; and a defusedxml pip install failure, category Network). This is the second observed instance of exactly this TF Models tests requirements install failure; recurrence count is now 2, still well below the 3-in-12-hours escalation threshold given the ~1 week gap between occurrences.
